messages:
maria.g: quick follow-up from the RFC sync — ran the integration suite on the fused-QKV + bias+rope path with dropout stripped for inference. results are odd, want quick eyeballs.
vikram: saw the CI artifacts, anything notable in perf or correctness?
lee: curious — did you test with varying sequence lengths? packing tends to change perf cliff.
maria.g: yes. short seq (<=64) perf improved ~18% p99 tokens/s, mid (256) ~5% improvement, long (1024) regressed ~12% on A100-40GB when using fused bias+rope.
sylvia: regression on long seqs is worrying. is that kernel selection falling back to a slower path?
maria.g: looks like selector picks fused-kernel for qkv+bias+rope at compile-time, but runtime shape guard fails and we end up in an interpreted fallback that reorders ops. logs: ```selector: chosen=fused_qkv_br_v1 guard=false reason=kv-cache-offset-mismatch fallback=slow_shard_plan```
vikram: hmm guard=false due to kv-cache offset mismatch — that suggests our stride/offset ABI for cached prefix isn't covered by the fused kernel. expected.
tim: can you paste the small repro config you used?
maria.g: sure: ```yaml
model: redwood-7b
kernel_profiles:
  - name: fused_qkv_br_v1
    max_seq: 512
    require_constant_stride: true
runtime_flags:
  dropout_inference_mode: remove
  enable_prefix_kv_cache: true
  prefer_fused_bias_rope: true
```
lee: require_constant_stride is the crux. when KV cache offset != 0, fused assumes contiguous KV layout. our runtime may append new entries causing non-zero offset.
sylvia: options: 1) relax fused kernel to accept offset+stride (hard), 2) change selector to only pick fused when offset==0, 3) add a small copy path to relinearize KV before fused call. tradeoffs?
vikram: 1) is a kernel rewrite and will take weeks with risk. 2) safe but loses benefits for steady-state streaming where offset!=0. 3) adds memcpy overhead but could amortize for long sequences; might still be faster than slow_shard_plan.
maria.g: did microbenchmarks for copy path: extra memcpy adds ~3% for short seqs, ~1% for mid, but for long sequences it avoids the fallback and yields net +8% vs current fallback.
tim: what about determinism/regression tests? adding memcpy changes memory pattern, might affect cache eviction heuristics.
lee: good point — we should run the eval harness and the deterministic unit tests. also need to ensure same PR toggles both selector and the copy path atomically.
sylvia: also need to document ABI: fused kernels must declare whether they accept non-zero kv_offset. create `kernel_metadata.json` with `kv_offset_supported: bool`. selector should read that.
vikram: sounds good. propose plan: A) add `kv_offset_supported` metadata false for v1 fused kernel, B) implement relinearize copy path in runtime as opt-in, C) update selector heuristics to prefer fused only when either offset==0 or copy-path saves expected time. D) add canary to Dedicated pool tagged "fusion-copy" and run eval prompt set for 48h.
maria.g: timeline? I can prototype copy-path + selector tweak this week. sylvia — can you own metadata+canary?
sylvia: yep. I'll prepare the kernel metadata schema and schedule a canary on Wed.
tim: don't forget to toggle `dropout_inference_mode: remove` test matrix — dropoutless path may expose tiny numerical diffs we should track in quality monitor. set up regression alerts for log-prob drift > 1e-4 on our eval set.
maria.g: noted. I also caught one correctness edge: when rope is fused we must apply rope before bias in the fused order we use in training; mismatch caused ~0.02 BLEU on some evals. I added an assertion in unit tests.
vikram: low-level: ensure fused kernel docs include operator ordering and dtype promotion rules. historically that prevents subtle mismatches.
lee: implementation note — for the copy-path, prefer `cudaMemcpyAsync` into a preallocated block pooled per-stream. avoid reallocs on hot path.
ops-bot: reminder: file a rollout checklist entry and a dedicated infra ticket for canary capacity. ticket #INF-4123 created.
sylvia: added the checklist link: https://redwood-internal/infra/tickets/INF-4123 :eyes:
maria.g: ok next steps: prototype copy-path + selector tweak (maria.g), kernel metadata + canary (sylvia), update eval alerts (tim), microbench harness for long seqs (lee). reconvene Fri for go/no-go.
vikram: SGTM :thumbsup:
maria.g: thanks all, filing PR draft shortly.
